# Drop the build dependency v3.5.1 added

v3.5.1 started reading the SF Mono dmg with `7zz`, because Homebrew's build sandbox no longer lets
`hdiutil attach` mount a disk image. It works, but it puts a third-party unpacker in the way of
four font files, and it turns out not to be needed: only *mounting* is blocked. `hdiutil convert`
needs none of the Mach services the sandbox denies, so the tools already on the machine are
enough.

The dmg is now converted to a plain image, and `SF Mono Fonts.pkg` is copied out of it by finding
the one xar archive it holds. `sevenzip` is no longer a build dependency, and the formula asks for
nothing that is not there already.

The extraction is checked, which it never was while `hdiutil` did the work. The four fonts taken
out of the pkg are compared against the SHA-256 the pinned dmg carries, and the pkg has to be the
only xar archive on the image. Reading the wrong bytes cannot go unnoticed: `xar` holds a SHA-1 of
every file it carries and refuses to extract on a mismatch, and the font checksums have to line up
after that.

Nothing about the fonts changed. They are the same files v3.5.0 and v3.5.1 built from.
